file.r.note: The R logo's ring and R in two colours (Huan, 2026-11-16), geometry from Developer Icons' r.svg.

file.shell.note: Generic shell-script artwork represents sh, Bash and zsh.

file.quarto.note: Gruvbox Material's Quarto quarters in two blues (Huan, 2026-11-16).

file.rmarkdown.note: Drawn for Sandhill: a page with Markdown's down arrow and a small R logo (Huan, 2026-11-16).

file.agent-notes.note: Gruvbox's agent artwork for agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md).

file.notebook.note: Gruvbox Material's Jupyter mark with the logo's two colours, orange arcs and grey moons (Huan, 2026-11-16).

file.fasta.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: FASTA sequences: a DNA helix.

file.fastq.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: FASTQ reads: a helix over per-base quality bars.

file.alignment.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Aligned reads (BAM, SAM, CRAM) stacked in a pileup.

file.variants.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Variant records (VCF, BCF): a variant pinned on a sequence.

file.annotation.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Gene annotations (GFF, GTF): a gene model, exons joined by introns.

file.intervals.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Genomic intervals (BED) with their bounds.

file.signal.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Signal tracks (bigWig, bigBed, wiggle): coverage along the genome.

file.index.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Index files (BAI, CRAI, FAI, TBI, CSI): entries pointing into another file.

file.tree.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Phylogenetic trees (Newick, Nexus): a rooted tree.

file.r-object.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Saved R objects (RDS, RData): a box.

file.anndata.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: AnnData (.h5ad): a matrix with row and column annotations.

file.hdf5.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: HDF5 and Loom: groups holding datasets, a tree.

file.sparse-matrix.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Matrix Market (.mtx): a matrix with few entries.

file.parquet.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Parquet: data stored by column.

file.nextflow.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Nextflow: a workflow joining steps.

file.wdl.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: WDL: a chain of workflow tasks.

file.cwl.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: CWL: a workflow fanning out to steps.

file.excel.note: Drawn for Sandhill in Gruvbox Material's document style: Excel workbooks, a spreadsheet grid cut out of a green document, not Microsoft's logo. Gruvbox has no Excel artwork; its table icon remains for delimited text.

folder.data.note: Database-folder artwork represents source datasets, without implying a database service.

folder.results.note: Distribution/output-folder artwork represents generated analysis results.

folder.figures.note: Image-folder artwork represents figures and plots.

folder.sandhill.note: Configuration-folder artwork denotes .sandhill settings; the crane/app identity is unchanged.

folder.notebooks.note: Jupyter-folder artwork represents the notebook/analysis-document family, including non-Jupyter documents.

folder.cache.note: Temporary-folder artwork represents cache, temporary and work directories.

folder.qc.note: Drawn for Sandhill: a badge with a tick, for quality-control reports.

folder.fastq.note: Drawn for Sandhill: the FASTQ file's wave and quality bars.

folder.bam.note: Drawn for Sandhill: the BAM file's pileup.

folder.tenx.note: Drawn for Sandhill: barcoded droplets, for Cell Ranger and Space Ranger output; not 10x Genomics' mark.

agent.codex.note: OpenAI's logo identifies the Codex integration (Huan), without a background; the app draws the one-colour mark in the surrounding text colour so it reads on light and dark.

agent.antigravity.note: Original full-colour SVG supplied by Huan; redistribution license not supplied.

agent.posit.note: Posit's blue and orange mark, as on Posit Assistant's site, from the official logo at posit.co; cropped to the mark without the wordmark, white background removed (Huan). Redistribution license not supplied.

agent.openscience.note: Synthetic Sciences mark supplied by Huan (from syntheticsciences.ai/img/logo.svg), without a background (Huan). Its site draws it dark on light and light on dark; the app draws it in the surrounding text colour to do the same. Redistribution license not supplied.

agent.omp.note: Official Oh My Pi mark (omp.sh/favicon.svg, the same file as can1357/oh-my-pi packages/collab-web/public/favicon.svg at b16bfbe0f9cf953d9a37fc17284967ed18fae015, MIT): the gradient π without its dark tile (Huan), cropped to the mark.

agent.pi.note: Official pi mark (https://pi.dev/logo.svg, the same mark as earendil-works/pi apps/p2/public/icons/favicon.svg, MIT), cropped to the mark without the original's empty margin.

agent.generic.note: Generic conversational-bot artwork for unbranded agent integrations.

lang.nextflow.note: Generic workflow artwork for the Nextflow runtime; not the Nextflow logo.

lang.shell.note: Bash artwork represents the general shell runtime category.
